title: The Lives of the Saints, Volume 02 (of 16): February
summary: "The Lives of the Saints, Volume 02 (of 16): February" by S. Baring-Gould is part of a sixteen-volume collection first published between 1872 and 1877. This February volume presents biographical accounts of saints whose principal feast days fall during the second month of the year. As one installment in Baring-Gould's comprehensive hagiographical work, it offers readers a window into the lives, deeds, and legacies of those venerated by the Church, organized by the calendar of sacred commemoration.
